description: Investigate claim-autoleave-continuation with two independently bootstrapped histories: control and transfer_timeout. Both elect node 1, commit JointImplicit learner addition, and make voter 3 unavailable immediately before leader application. Only transfer_timeout invokes TransferLeader(3) at that point. Apply each committed configuration before Advance. Service live-node ticks and all generated traffic/persistence, then compare complete observed protocol state after ticks 20 and 30. Measure a forbidden recurring idle cycle with unfulfilled AutoLeave, not absence of progress by an assumed deadline. Emit the full state at both endpoints plus eligibility, queue, progress and quorum diagnostics. A post-result ordinary proposal probes recovery without changing the idle observation.

harness.description: Three actual RawNodes start from a common empty-application snapshot index/term 1 with voters 1,2,3. Driver calls Campaign, ProposeConfChange, TransferLeader, Tick, Ready, ApplyConfChange, Advance and Step. MemoryStorage stands in for completed synchronous durability; network drops all traffic to/from unavailable voter 3 after admission and to absent learner 4. Live nodes receive every message FIFO and complete all Ready work. Reflection reads protocol fields including private tracker inflight/sentCommit and MemoryStorage contents; it changes no target state.
semantic_changes: No target behavior changes. MemoryStorage models completed persistence without physical crash recovery.
Unavailable node 3 stops stepping/ticking after commitment; new learner 4 has no instantiated process. Neither is needed for the live majority of either voter set.

Read-only reflection omits logger, traceLogger, tick/step function pointers and MemoryStorage callStats. Role identifies dispatch; no election/random draw occurs within the witnessed stable-leader heartbeat cycle. Driver observation counters are not protocol transition inputs.

legality.derivation: NewRawNode permits configuration bootstrap via Storage; identical snapshot/HardState establish initial history. All later support comes from real peer calls, never injected acknowledgments or forged commit indexes. Ready is persisted before messages, committed entries alone are applied, and Advance follows application. Serial TransferLeader during an outstanding Ready occurs between actual commitment and ApplyConfChange; no competing RawNode call or source mutation is used. RawNode permits Step/transfer while Ready is outstanding and only requires completion before next synchronous Ready. The same unavailable-target fault is applied to control.
legality.applicability: Synchronous RawNode with actual three-node election/commit, persisted Ready entries/HardState, ordered application, an unavailable transfer target and responsive voters 1 and 2.

grounding.derivation: The result is always emitted after the fixed schedule and correlates to admitted JointImplicit by scenario and joint_index. stranded_cycle is computed from actual repeated full protocol snapshots, drained live Ready/application/network work, ten real heartbeat responses, live majority membership, continuing leader and no transferee, AutoLeave with outgoing voters, applied >= pendingConfIndex, and no emitted empty exit entry. Full endpoint state is retained for correspondence review. A recurring deterministic cycle under the same fair live-quorum schedule cannot generate an exit unless a non-cycle input arrives. This applies the automatic-work obligation without imposing a numeric deadline.
grounding.applicability: Synchronous RawNode with actual three-node election/commit, persisted Ready entries/HardState, ordered application, an unavailable transfer target and responsive voters 1 and 2.

observable_properties.description: An admitted implicit configuration must not remain unfulfilled in the measured closed, fully serviced, continuing-leader cycle after transfer obstruction is absent. The monitor checks the computed recurring-cycle predicate, not Go test success or a raw elapsed-time threshold.

uncertainties: State recurrence supports continuation only if the recorded state and excluded fields accurately cover transition inputs; semantic review must check the reflection omissions and source paths.
A nonrecurring result excludes this finite witness only; it does not establish general eventual liveness.
The tested implicit change adds a learner and retains identical incoming/outgoing voter sets; no client outage or changing-voter consequence is measured.
The later user proposal is a recovery diagnostic after the result, not a prerequisite or part of the recurring idle schedule.
